Dear Halden Pay Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Senior Data Engineer – Data Platform position. In my current role at Lukovac Freight Hub, I own the design, ingestion, orchestration and day-to-day operation of a production data platform built with Airflow, Snowflake, dbt and Kafka. I would bring that hands-on platform experience to a team building shared, reusable data capabilities for analysts, data scientists and product teams.

Recent work includes building a shipment-event pipeline processing around 30 million events per day, with end-to-end latency under two minutes at p95, and adding dead-letter and replay tooling to reprocess failed events without data loss. I also migrated approximately 300 stored procedures into tested, documented dbt models, introducing incremental processing and clearer lineage while reducing the nightly warehouse build from 5 hours 10 minutes to 1 hour 35 minutes. In 2024, I reduced monthly Snowflake spend from approximately $38,000 to $24,000 through warehouse sizing, auto-suspend and removal of unused tables.

My earlier experience at Kovalent Pay is especially relevant to Halden Pay’s payments work. I built PySpark jobs on AWS EMR for a transaction reconciliation engine matching bank settlement files against internal ledgers, reducing manual finance-team reconciliation from around three days to four hours per month-end. I have also contributed two merged pull requests to an Airflow provider package, fixing a pagination bug and adding tests. Alongside mentoring engineers and running data-platform office hours, these experiences reflect the ownership, collaboration and practical focus on reducing complexity that I would bring to the role.

I hold an MSc in Computer Science from Northgate Technical University, where my thesis was about incremental materialized views. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience building and operating data platforms could contribute to Halden Pay’s Data Platform team.

Kind regards,
Lena Varga-Holm
